cases.sentence: Исчисли вместе с ___ всех израилетян, годных к военной службе.
cases.translation: Count, together with Aaron, all the Israelites fit for military service.
cases.explain: The phrase вместе с (together with) takes the instrumental → Аароном.

cases.sentence: Пусть от каждого ___ вам помогает один человек.
cases.translation: Let one man from each tribe help you.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive → рода.

cases.sentence: Пусть они будут носить ___ и всю ее утварь.
cases.translation: Let them carry the Tabernacle and all its furnishings.
cases.explain: Скиния is the direct object of носить (to carry) → accusative; feminine -я nouns take -ю.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне будут ставить шатры по ополчениям, каждый в своем лагере, под своим ___.
cases.translation: The Israelites shall pitch their tents by divisions, each in his own camp, under his own standard.
cases.explain: The preposition под marking location takes the instrumental → знаменем.

cases.sentence: Так он исчислил их в Синайской ___.
cases.translation: So he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition в marking location takes the prepositional → пустыне.

cases.sentence: Если к ней приблизится посторонний, он будет предан ___.
cases.translation: If a stranger comes near it, he shall be put to death.
cases.explain: The idiom предать смерти (to put to death) takes the dative → смерти.

cases.sentence: …всех израилетян, годных к военной ___, от двадцати лет и старше.
cases.translation: …all the Israelites fit for military service, from twenty years old and upward.
cases.explain: The preposition к (fit for) governs the dative → службе.

cases.translation: Of Reuben: Elizur, the son of Shedeur.
cases.explain: Сын stands in apposition naming Elizur, who is nominative → nominative.

reading.ru: Пусть от каждого рода вам помогает один человек, который является главой своей семьи.
reading.question: Who from each tribe shall help Moses?
options: One man who is the head of his family
reading.correct: One man who is the head of his family
reading.explain: The text says one man, the head of his family, from each tribe shall help.

reading.ru: Всего их было шестьсот три тысячи пятьсот пятьдесят.
reading.question: What was the total number of those counted?
reading.explain: The text gives the grand total as six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

reading.ru: Однако семьи из рода Левия не были исчислены вместе с остальными.
reading.question: Which tribe was NOT counted with the others?
reading.explain: The text states the families of the tribe of Levi were not counted with the rest.

reading.ru: Если к ней приблизится посторонний, он будет предан смерти.
reading.question: What happens to an outsider who approaches the tabernacle?
options: He shall be put to death
reading.correct: He shall be put to death
reading.explain: The text says a stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

reading.ru: Левиты будут нести стражу при скинии свидетельства.
reading.question: What responsibility do the Levites have?
options: To guard the tabernacle of the testimony
reading.correct: To guard the tabernacle of the testimony
reading.explain: The text says the Levites shall keep watch over the tabernacle of the testimony.

reading.ru: В роду Рувима их было сорок шесть тысяч пятьсот.
reading.question: How many were counted in the tribe of Reuben?
reading.explain: The text gives the tribe of Reuben as forty-six thousand five hundred.
